note: Files the Smart Installer must never silently overwrite in the Duty folder. Generalizes the XInput/ASI-loader protection that keeps the working LSPDFR launch alive. Levels: critical (block or high-risk), warning (surface + confirm).

protected.note: XInput1_4.dll is the Ultimate ASI Loader. Overwriting it with the small RPH hook copy stops DirectStorageFix and every ASI mod from loading.
Alternate ASI loader. Do not replace it with a smaller hook DLL.
Must stay LoadPlugin "LSPD First Response.dll". ReloadAllPlugins breaks LSPDFR on Enhanced.
The hook host itself. Replacing it can break the working launch.
PluginTimeoutThreshold must stay 60000 and ConsoleKey F4. RPH rejects other timeout values.
The game executable. Never replace it.
BattlEye launcher. The manager parks this for Story Mode; a mod should not restore it.
Steam launch shim required to keep Story Mode in the LSPDFR folder.
The LSPDFR plugin. Only an LSPDFR update should replace it, and it must stay inside Plugins\.
Holds -nobattleye. Losing it makes Story Mode mods crash.

blockedIncoming.note: LSPDFR IL-merges JSON.NET. A loose Newtonsoft.Json.dll breaks the plugin load. Never install it.
